## Growing cells outside the body

Scientists have developed methods to grow plant and animal cells outside the body. This is called **cell culture**. Cells are taken from an organism and placed in a nutrient-rich medium that allows them to grow and multiply.

<!-- STEP -->
## Keeping the culture safe

The culture needs the right temperature, the right acidic or alkaline conditions, and moisture, all under sterile conditions. Cell culture is crucial for studying how cells work, and for producing biochemicals, food, medicines, vaccines and more.
